datasets.name: JPL SBDB trans-Neptunian objects (all catalogued)
datasets.organization: NASA JPL SSD (orbits derived from Minor Planet Center astrometry)
datasets.purpose: Kuiper belt / scattered disk / detached-object point cloud
datasets.mechanism: SBDB Query API (sb-class=TNO) -> JSON -> Float32 binary
datasets.license: U.S. Government (NASA/JPL-Caltech) public data service; no license or reuse restrictions are stated by JPL SSD/CNEOS. Use is governed by the JPL SSD/CNEOS API Fair Use Policy (one request at a time, application-specific User-Agent, cache results, no embedding of the APIs in websites per NASA CORS policy). Do not imply NASA/JPL endorsement.
datasets.citation: NASA/JPL Solar System Dynamics, Small-Body Database Query API; orbits fitted to Minor Planet Center observations.
datasets.rateLimits: JPL SSD/CNEOS API Fair Use Policy: no numeric limit published; only one request at a time (no simultaneous requests); back off on errors; JPL may throttle or block unreasonable load. Scripts use sequential requests with >= 1.1 s spacing.
datasets.fallback: No TNO cloud is drawn if the file is missing; named dwarf planets still render from the solar domain.
datasets.limitations: Observational census, heavily biased towards bright, near-ecliptic, near-perihelion objects; osculating elements drift beyond a few decades from epoch; dynamical class is a heuristic box. Not a model of the true population.

datasets.name: Heliosphere boundary crossings and outer-system constants (published values)
datasets.organization: Published literature (NASA Voyager and IBEX teams)
datasets.purpose: Voyager termination-shock / heliopause crossings, interstellar-flow direction, Oort-cloud extents, shell-fit anchors
datasets.mechanism: Transcribed by hand from publications; no network access
datasets.version: Stone 2005, 2008, 2013, 2019; Gurnett 2013; Bzowski 2015; Oort 1950; Hills 1981; Dones 2015
datasets.license: Facts and measured values cited from peer-reviewed papers; no text or figures reproduced.
datasets.citation: Stone et al. 2005 Science 309, 2017; Stone et al. 2008 Nature 454, 71; Stone et al. 2013 Science 341, 150; Gurnett et al. 2013 Science 341, 1489; Stone et al. 2019 Nature Astron. 3, 1013; Bzowski et al. 2015 ApJS 220, 28; Oort 1950 BAN 11, 91; Hills 1981 AJ 86, 1730; Dones et al. 2015 Space Sci. Rev. 197, 191.
datasets.limitations: Heliosphere shell shapes between the four crossings are reconstructed (a smooth fitted model), the tail is unconstrained, and the Oort cloud is hypothesised: it is rendered as an illustrative random sample.
